name: Matt Keating
occupation: Natrona County commissioner-elect taking office in January 2027. Oil City News reported that he served as Natrona County assessor from 2018 through 2022.
prior_offices: Natrona County assessor (2018–2022; Oil City News reported he lost the 2022 election to Tammy Saulsbury)
background: Matt Keating is a Natrona County commissioner-elect and takes office in January 2027, succeeding Peter C. Nicolaysen, who is serving through the current term. Oil City News reported that he served as Natrona County assessor from 2018 through 2022 and lost that year's election to Tammy Saulsbury, and that he ran for county commissioner in the 2024 Republican primary, placing fifth with 3,011 votes. He won one of three commission seats in the November 2026 general election; Oil City News reported he received 11,054 votes.
